title: batch.submit silently caps at 50 items per call — chunk inputs or you lose the overflow
summary: When processing a list through batch.submit, a single submit call silently accepts at most 50 items per call and DROPS the rest with no error and no partial flag — the returned receipt array just comes back short. Found when a 120-item submit returned only 50 receipts. To process every item you MUST chunk the input into batches of <=50 and call submit repeatedly, summing the receipt counts, until all items are consumed. A naive single submit(items) undercounts for any input over 50.
